info.title: GovCon CPARS Self Assessment 14 Day Rebuttal API
info.description: Transforms contract performance metrics (SLA attainment, CDRL on-time delivery, cost variance, key personnel stability, small business utilization) and Assessing Official draft CPAR narratives into a FAR 42.1503 Table 42-1 justified CPARS Self-Assessment Package and a formal 14-Calendar-Day Reviewing Official Rebuttal Brief. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Generate FAR 42.1503 CPARS Self-Assessment & 14-Day Reviewing Official Rebuttal
post.description: Transforms contract performance metrics and draft Assessing Official CPARs into a FAR 42.1503 Table 42-1 justified Self-Assessment Package and a 14-Calendar-Day Reviewing Official Rebuttal Brief.

contract_metrics_and_assessing_official_.description: Contract performance metrics (SLA attainment, CDRL on-time delivery, cost variance, key personnel fill rate, small business goals) and, if rebutting a draft CPAR, the Assessing Official's draft ratings and narrative.

cpar_submission_mode.description: Submission mode under FAR 42.1503: Proactive Annual Self-Assessment Package, 14-Calendar-Day Draft CPAR Rebuttal to Reviewing Official, or Both.

target_far_42_1503_rating_goal.description: Target FAR 42.1503 Table 42-1 rating outcome across Quality, Schedule, Cost Control, Management, Small Business, and Regulatory Compliance.

example.contract_metrics_and_assessing_official_: Contract W52P1J-24-F-0188 (Period of Performance: Oct 1, 2025 – Sep 30, 2026). Contractor Metrics: 99.97% Cloud Enclave Uptime (PWS SLA >= 99.5%); 48 of 48 CDRLs delivered on or ahead of schedule (100% first-time COR acceptance); automated DevSecOps pipeline cut vulnerability remediation time by 64% saving 3,200 Government labor hours; Cost Variance: 2.8% under CPFF ceiling ($410K underrun returned); Small Business Subcontracting: achieved 28.4% SB vs. 23.0% goal. Draft AO Narrative Issue: AO assigned 'Satisfactory' across Quality and Schedule, citing a 3-week Milestone 2 delay that was caused by Government GFE SIPRNet circuit provisioning delay documented in COR Email 2026-03-14.
